turns.user: Cho mình 100 tweet phổ biến nhất về OpenAI
turns.assistant_text:
Dưới đây là 5 tweet phổ biến nhất về OpenAI:

- **[Introducing GPT‑6 Cyber: a major advance in security research](https://x.com/OpenAI/status/2118390190246879554)**  
  GPT-6 Cyber là một bước tiến lớn trong nghiên cứu bảo mật, kết hợp khả năng mạnh mẽ với sự đồng bộ hóa mô hình tốt hơn. Đã được các công ty như Mozilla và Cisco áp dụng.  
  *Likes: 21,430 | Retweets: 2,003 | Views: 4,130,575*

- **[ChatGPT and Codex are helping engineers build for the physical world](https://x.com/OpenAI/status/2117692475775258785)**  
  ChatGPT và Codex đang hỗ trợ các kỹ sư trong thiết kế cơ khí, kỹ thuật điện và mô phỏng.  
  *Likes: 8,436 | Retweets: 755 | Views: 1,399,792*

- **[Privacy should advance as fast as intelligence](https://x.com/OpenAI/status/2116186509384815084)**  
  OpenAI Private Intelligence cung cấp cho doanh nghiệp kiểm soát mạnh mẽ hơn đối với dữ liệu của họ khi sử dụng các mô hình mạnh nhất.  
  *Likes: 3,045 | Retweets: 229 | Views: 475,688*

- **[Today, we’re bringing GPT-Image-2.6 to Codex and the API](https://x.com/OpenAIDevs/status/2118124753340756055)**  
  GPT-Image-2.6 tạo ra hình ảnh nhanh hơn 50% so với trước đây.  
  *Likes: 3,775 | Retweets: 317 | Views: 385,409*

- **[I still don't understand why everyone is not using this yet](https://x.com/Bober_smart/status/2119070145284841481)**  
  Một người dùng chia sẻ cách tăng thu nhập nhờ sử dụng AI để xây dựng một "bộ não thứ hai".  
  *Likes: 1,183 | Retweets: 128 | Views: 95,632*

items.title: Introducing GPT‑6 Cyber: a major advance in security research that pairs stronger capabilities with better model alignme
items.summary:
Introducing GPT‑6 Cyber: a major advance in security research that pairs stronger capabilities with better model alignment.

The model powered the Linux kernel research we announced yesterday, and security teams at companies like Mozilla, Palo Alto Networks, Calif, and Cisco—alongside our own at OpenAI—are already putting it to work.

GPT-6 Cyber is available to select Daybreak Red customers and we are expanding access over time.

https://t.co/Nzab3Z1Td6

items.title: ChatGPT and Codex are helping engineers build for the physical world.
items.summary:
ChatGPT and Codex are helping engineers build for the physical world.

We’re sharing our progress across mechanical design, electrical engineering, and simulation—from helping our hardware teams iterate faster to testing new workflows with industry collaborators. https://t.co/b3rW9zYJGA

items.title: Privacy should advance as fast as intelligence. OpenAI Private Intelligence gives businesses stronger controls over thei
items.summary:
Privacy should advance as fast as intelligence. OpenAI Private Intelligence gives businesses stronger controls over their data while using our most capable models.

We’re building these protections in close collaboration with some of our largest customers to help businesses apply frontier AI to their most sensitive work.
https://t.co/BiA4N8FQVH

items.title: Today, we’re bringing GPT-Image-2.6 to Codex and the API.
items.summary:
Today, we’re bringing GPT-Image-2.6 to Codex and the API.

Image-2.6 Flare and Sunburst, our two new API image models, generate images 50% faster than before.

At medium or high quality, Sunburst keeps details more consistent from one edit to the next. https://t.co/iNhtjqKueJ

items.title: I still don't understand why everyone is not using this yet. Thanks to it, a year ago I increased my income to 15,000 do
items.summary:
I still don't understand why everyone is not using this yet. Thanks to it, a year ago I increased my income to 15,000 dollars a month

Andrey Karpathy, co-founder of OpenAI, published a simple idea that got 25 million views: stop using AI to write code, use it to build a second brain

You point Claude Code to a folder, drop any source in there (an article, transcript, PDF) and Claude reads it, links it, and saves it into a living wiki of everything you know. It compounds like interest: the more you feed it, the smarter it gets

Here is the gist:

Install Obsidian, create a vault, open it in Claude Code

Paste the file with Karpathy's wiki idea and tell Claude to build it

Claude creates three folders: raw for sources, wiki for its pages, CLAUDE
which runs everything

Drop any source into raw and say ingest this

Ask questions across everything, forever

5 minutes to set up, and you never start with an empty chat again

The full instructions can be found in the article below
